name: indec-mcp
description: Retrieve traceable official Argentine economic statistics through INDEC MCP.

interface.longDescription: Retrieve official Argentine inflation, Gran Buenos Aires basic basket costs, national economic activity and EPH unemployment statistics with reference periods, coverage, statistical flags and source links. Independent service; not an INDEC product or endorsement. Wage growth and wage/inflation comparison are currently unavailable because the documented INDEC wage endpoint returns HTTP 404. Historical publication vintages are not reconstructed.
defaultPrompt: What is Argentina's latest national monthly inflation?
How much is the basic total basket per adult equivalent in Gran Buenos Aires?
How has unemployment changed across the latest available quarters?

publication.release_notes: Initial review draft. Inflation, baskets, EMAE and unemployment have live verified mappings. Wage tools remain unavailable.

es-AR.subtitle: Estadísticas de Argentina
es-AR.description: Estadísticas oficiales de Argentina, consultables desde ChatGPT y Codex. Servicio independiente basado en datos oficiales del INDEC, con períodos de referencia, cobertura y fuentes. Los salarios y su comparación con la inflación están temporalmente indisponibles porque el endpoint documentado devuelve HTTP 404.
